### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **5** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **4** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/validate-component-props.ts`, `packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/ui.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`  _(via PageSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **4** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/validate-component-props.ts`, `packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/ui.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **142** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3fed1eb00af6520f1f26e774195b0819d94fb254` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `96632c5140e44b1c089988ad3ac43ba3fb6fd0c6` — the merge of head `40624b325e96cfb7d12b216a22ff75c418546a3f` into base `3fed1eb00af6520f1f26e774195b0819d94fb254`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 96632c5140e44b1c089988ad3ac43ba3fb6fd0c6 && git checkout 96632c5140e44b1c089988ad3ac43ba3fb6fd0c6
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 3fed1eb00af6520f1f26e774195b0819d94fb254 40624b325e96cfb7d12b216a22ff75c418546a3f && git checkout -B drift-repro 3fed1eb00af6520f1f26e774195b0819d94fb254 && git merge --no-ff 40624b325e96cfb7d12b216a22ff75c418546a3f

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3fed1eb00af6520f1f26e774195b0819d94fb254
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 3fed1eb00af6520f1f26e774195b0819d94fb254` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2aaff0348955eb01dfd61512e5494c57905974b5`
Local-runs: none

Face: published schema (`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`, `view.zod.ts`, `conversions/refused-shapes.ts`, two step-18 entries); no governed path in the 14-file list (`Governed Surface Queue Guard` success on this head). Ruling executed: `6161173492` on #23388, item 6, verbatim: "Once this PR lands, that judge overlaps the general rule and is deleted (one operation, two implementations: the governed side wins), in #23357's PR if it is still open, else in a one-line follow-up." Landed predecessor: PR #23418 (`d0c09e47c1`), which put `validateComponentProps` on the runtime publish door for `page` writes. Read in this act: the head's net diff over its merge-base `29c7157af4` (14 files, +233/−468, equal to the PR's file list), card #23447 with its three comments, the ruling, PR #23418's body and file list, and the head's check-runs. Nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`PageSchema`'s accept set WIDENS by one shape — RIGHT.** `checkPageComponentViewData`, `VIEW_DATA_SOURCE_COMPONENT_TYPES`, the `.superRefine` and the `ViewDataSchema` import leave `page.zod.ts`, so `PageSchema.safeParse`, `definePage()`, `defineStack({ pages })` and the `page` metadata-type schema now accept an `object-grid` / `object-map` / `object-gantt` / `object-tree` component whose `properties.data.provider` is the retired `api`, at regions, `page:tabs` items, nested containers and slots. That is the deletion item 6 orders and the card's item 1 names (the `.superRefine` on `PageSchema` included). It restores the family's standing contract: the page parse leaves `properties` an open record and judges no `ComponentPropsMap` refusal — `defineStack` never refused an unknown key or a retired prop either; the narrow judge was the one exception, made because the save door did not run the rule.
2. **Door by door, where the general rule takes over — RIGHT at every door the rule reaches:**
   - `os validate`, `os build`, `os lint`: the `validateComponentProps` entry at the head reads `commands: ALL`, `surfaces: CLI_AND_RUNTIME`, `runtimeTypes: ['page']` (`authoring-rules.ts`), so each refuses with `component-props-invalid` carrying the retirement's own prescription (the row's `data` is `ViewDataSchema`). The dev measured validate and build; lint follows from `commands: ALL`.
   - The runtime save door, `saveMetaItem` (REST `PUT /api/v1/meta/page/:name`, the Studio, MCP through `runtime-authoring-gate.ts`; `importUnmanagedPackage` routes through `saveMetaItem` too): `evaluateRuntimeAuthoringGate` runs inside the save path (`protocol.ts`), 422 `INVALID_METADATA`, `rulesRun` names the rule, nothing stored. Pinned on the real path in `protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts` for all four types, the reach (a `page:tabs` item, `flex` › `page:card`, a slot) and the `object` / `value` control — the card's item 4, both halves.
   - Boot `loadMetaFromDb` and read `getMetaItem`: `invalid: 1` plus `[metadata_spec_invalid]` becomes `invalid: 0` with no warning; `_diagnostics.valid` `false` becomes `true`, served as stored. RIGHT: ruling item 1 and pin (b) say stored pages keep serving and only the next save is judged; the read diagnostic was a by-product of the deleted parse check, and the pin asserts the next save of that same body is refused and the fixed page saves. This also answers the card's item 3: the boot count is a committed pin now, not a deleted probe.
3. **One door refused before and accepts now with no rule behind it — RIGHT by the ruling, and named in the shipped text.** A code-defined stack evaluated by a host that never runs `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` (`os dev`, `os serve` and `os start` load the config and run no authoring rule; only `validate`, `compile`, `lint` and `verify` do) threw inside `defineStack` before and boots and serves the page now. Item 6 chooses the governed implementation, whose doors are the CLI's and the save door's, and every other props-row refusal already behaves this way at that door. The changeset's door table says it in so many words ("accepted (these doors run no lint rule)"), and the retirement entry's `acceptanceCriteria` now claims exactly the enforced doors (the view parse for a view; the component-props gate at the three CLI doors and the save door for a page component): the claim is as narrow as the enforcement. No shipped page carries the binding (`examples/`, `packages/platform-objects`, `skills/`: 0 hits at the head).
4. **The public surface NARROWS — RIGHT.** `checkPageComponentViewData` leaves `@objectstack/spec/ui`: `api-surface/ui.json` and `export-origins/ui.json` lose one line each (regenerated, not hand-edited), and the barrel absence plus the 0-declaration / 0-attachment pins follow the `checkListViewPageMount` precedent in `object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts` ("all four exports"). `VIEW_DATA_SOURCE_COMPONENT_TYPES` was module-private, so there is no second surface change. objectui at the pin `b9814b334d` (`.objectui-sha`): 0 references to either name, so the removal breaks no sibling build.
5. **Deleted tests — RIGHT, with the duplicates named here.** `page-component-view-data.test.ts`: the parse-refusal and walker-loop assertions lose their subject with the judge; the reach and control cases live on at the save door (item 2 above); the two-direction derivation (the four types are exactly the `ComponentPropsMap` rows whose `data` refuses with the prescription) survives in `refused-shapes.test.ts` ("agrees with the refusing door", present at the merge-base and at the head), where the parse-accepts fact is pinned too. The #23357 block of `protocol.save-union-issues.test.ts` asserted a parse-union `custom` issue and `_diagnostics.valid: false`, both false now; its save-door half is superseded by the new block. The PR body names the save-door pins but not `refused-shapes.test.ts` as the derivation's home: a nit for the seat's ACCEPT, not a gap.
6. **Rewritten sentences, each read against the head — true:** the `refused-shapes.ts` docblocks and `COMPONENT_API_BINDING_FATE` (loads, served as stored, no read diagnostic, the console keeps reading it, next save 422 by the props gate; `VIEW_API_BINDING_FATE` untouched, rightly, since the view parse still refuses a view); `18.view-data-api-provider-retired.ts` `acceptanceCriteria`; `18.ui-page-action-row-declarative-update-rules.ts` `reason`; the `validate-component-props.ts` header; the `view.zod.ts` comment; the `PageSchema` trailing comment. A tree grep at the head finds the deleted names only in the two changesets and the absence pins.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/23447-page-component-view-data-judge-deleted.md`: `@objectstack/spec: minor` with the BREAKING banner, the FROM → TO table, the one-line fix and the measured door table. It matches the diff: a published export removed (BREAKING, shipped as `minor` under the repo's launch-window convention; no `major` in pre mode) and an accept-set change on a published schema. RIGHT.
- The ADR-0087 disposition marker in the changeset body reads not-required (already-registered `view-data-api-provider-retired`). RIGHT: the retirement is that step-18 entry and this diff deletes a second implementation of its page-component half; `Lint & Repo Gates` is green on the head.
- The declaration: the changeset carries the arm, `yes (narrowing)`; the PR body and the claim carry `yes` with no arm. `yes` because `PageSchema`'s accept set widens; `(narrowing)` because the public surface narrows — the widens-one-surface-narrows-another combination `clause2-line.mjs` defines — and the three carriers agree. RIGHT.
- `@objectstack/lint: patch`: the whole lint diff is the file-top comment of `validate-component-props.ts`, declared text-only by the dev. Over-declared: a lint release with nothing behind it, whose CHANGELOG entry would carry a `feat(spec)!` BREAKING line about a spec export. Not wrong in effect (`Check Changeset` green); the seat may drop the lint line at ACCEPT.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev deviations (report `6206321093`):
1. CLI probe fixtures committed in `ee76df23` and removed in `26c3fee4`: the net diff carries none (14 files, no `packages/cli/.tmp-23447`). Clean.
2. The dispatch named `.changeset/pre/23357-*` as a released note. At the head the note sits at `.changeset/23357-page-component-view-data-api-refused.md`, `.changeset/pre/` does not exist, `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` carries no 23357 entry and spec is at `18.0.0-next.1`, so it is PENDING, not released. Judged under open question 2 below.
3. Pins in `protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts` rather than `protocol.save-union-issues.test.ts`: right. The refusal is a rule verdict, not a parse-union issue, that harness carries the boot/read rig, and both files are in the claimed surface.
4. `lint: patch`: ② above.

Open question 1, the stale "not parsed on the metadata save or load path" family outside this card's surface: ESCALATED, option A. PR #23418 (`d0c09e47c1`) made it false, not this deletion, and it is outside the dispatched file surface, so the dev stopped at the fence rightly. Stale at the head, read in this act: THREE shipped `reason` strings, not one — `18.ui-page-action-row-operation-declared.ts` (absent from PR #23418's 36-file list), `18.ui-object-block-grouping-config-typed.ts` ("not parsed on the save path") and `18.element-text-variant-heading-subheading-retired.ts` (the same, and each names only the three CLI doors); the `exportOptions` TSDoc in `component.zod.ts` ("a stored page still saves and loads"), which ships in the `.d.ts`; eleven step-18 entry code comments; and the stored-shapes table of `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` ("a page still loads and saves"). The shipped strings are upgrade-guide and `os migrate meta` text, so this is a card, not an acceptance note: one `domain:spec` follow-up, one mechanical sweep, shipped strings and the `.d.ts` TSDoc first. The seat files it; this record writes nothing else.

Open question 2, the pending 23357 note: ESCALATED to the seat, with a judgment. On the day it ships beside this PR's note, four of its sentences are false: "is now refused by `PageSchema`"; "`definePage()`, `defineStack({ pages })` … refuse the page"; a stored page "registered under `[metadata_spec_invalid]` with the refusal in the `_diagnostics` of every read"; and "`checkPageComponentViewData` is exported from `@objectstack/spec/ui` … so a mirror … can re-attach it". Both notes compile into the same `@objectstack/spec` release section, and an upgrading agent grepping the tombstoned name lands on the false entry first. The dev's A (leave it) ships that contradiction; the dev's B (a docs-only PR later) is the remedy for a RELEASED entry and would trip the foreign-changeset rule in another PR anyway. The route of record for a pending note a diff makes false is PR #23418's own: amend it in the same PR as a DELIBERATE CORRECTION (`check-empty-changeset` reds by design, the PR says so, the maintainer confirms in writing; `6203578381` is the precedent). Recommendation: before landing, the dev strikes those sentences in `.changeset/23357-*.md` in this PR (what stays true is what the 23388 note already states), and the seat obtains the maintainer's word; the alternative, both entries shipping side by side, is the maintainer's to choose, not a seat's. This face is outside the three review faces, so it does not turn the verdict; it is the seat's ACCEPT condition.

Card item 3 (re-measure the stored-page fate before rewriting it): measured before the rewrite and committed as a pin — boot `loaded 1 / errors 0 / invalid 0`, registered, no `metadata_spec_invalid` warning; read `_diagnostics.valid: true`; next save 422 by the props rule; the fixed page saves.

Check-runs on `2aaff034`, read at 2026-10-16T02:27Z: all 41 completed, none pending, none red. The five queue-enforced contexts are green — `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core` (and each of its six shards), `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`. Also green: `Check Changeset`, `Spec property liveness`, `Check PR Size`, the card-claim and single-writer checks, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Check Documentation Links`, and every Lint and Type Check lane. Skipped on the PR run, as the full-battery jobs are: `Console Pin Gate`, `Temporal Conformance`, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, the sharded dogfood matrix, `Build Docs`, `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)`. Beyond the check-runs this record vouches for nothing it did not read: the dev's local gate sweep and ablation are the report's, taken at this same head.

## Maintainer confirmation: the pending 23357 release note is corrected in this PR (DELIBERATE CORRECTION) · recorded by `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · session `session_01LFqdRsuM5nkqoJdHd5ztVk` · 2026-10-16T07:13Z

The maintainer answered 「同意」 in this seat's session. The question had been put to them there at 2026-10-16T02:31Z, and repeated in each round report since. In the seat's words, it was: "correct the pending `.changeset/23357-*.md` in this PR as a DELIBERATE CORRECTION (#23418's precedent, `6203578381`), or let both notes ship". Their answer, verbatim: 「#23784（#23447）：同不同意在这个 PR 里直接改正 23357 那条说明 同意」.

**What it authorizes.** It covers `.changeset/23357-page-component-view-data-api-refused.md`, which is still pending: `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` carries no 23357 entry. Its four sentences that this PR makes false are struck or rewritten in this PR, per contract review `6206677361`, open question 2:
1. "is now refused by `PageSchema`".
2. "`definePage()`, `defineStack({ pages })` … refuse the page".
3. A stored page "registered under `[metadata_spec_invalid]` with the refusal in the `_diagnostics` of every read".
4. "`checkPageComponentViewData` is exported from `@objectstack/spec/ui` … so a mirror … can re-attach it".

Each new sentence is measured against this PR's head. What stays true stays: the FROM → TO table, the one-line fix, and the save door's 422.

**The check.** `Check Changeset` reds by design on a foreign-changeset edit. It is not a required context, and it runs only on `pull_request`, never on `merge_group`.

**Next.** A patch round to the dev session `session_016QpnMQNQ3TQ8mvWiHJwN2j` makes three changes:
- It merges `main` (PR #23708 and PR #23800 have landed), with the generated shards through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`.
- It makes the correction above.
- It drops the over-declared `'@objectstack/lint': patch` from this PR's own note, if the changeset gates allow it.

The seat then reviews the delta, ACCEPTs, readies the PR and arms auto-merge.

## Correction to `6210183493`: the 23357 note was already released, so no correction rides this PR · `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · session `session_01LFqdRsuM5nkqoJdHd5ztVk` · 2026-10-16T08:02Z

The premise of my confirmation record `6210183493` was false, and of the question the maintainer answered: that `.changeset/23357-page-component-view-data-api-refused.md` was still pending. The Version Packages PR #23481 landed on `main` as `e5136ff10f` at 2026-10-16T02:12Z, nineteen minutes before the question was put.
- It moved the note to `.changeset/pre/23357-page-component-view-data-api-refused.md`.
- It published the note's text in `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` under `## 18.0.0-next.2`. The "re-attach it" sentence is at `:165` on `main`.

The contract review read this PR's head from before that merge, and the seat repeated its reading without re-checking `main`. The dev found it in the patch round (report `6210894955`) and edited nothing there, which was right.

**What follows, by rule, not by a new question.** `AGENTS.md` (the `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` row of the release-owned table): "Factual error in a released entry → **amend that entry in a dedicated docs-only PR**, ⛔ never an erratum in a later entry and never a rider on code changes".
- So the maintainer's 「同意」 is not used on this PR, and this PR touches no foreign changeset.
- The four false sentences are corrected in a dedicated docs-only PR, under a card this seat files in this act.
- `Check Changeset` stays green on this PR.

**This PR, at head `39977e9542`.**
- It merged `main` (PR #23708, PR #23800). The generated shards were regenerated through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`.
- It dropped `'@objectstack/lint': patch`, and no changeset gate asks for it.
- CI is all green: 41 check-runs, 35 `success`, 6 `skipped`.
- The seat writes the body update that the dev's report spells out. A delta contract-review record on the merge resolution and the changeset follows, and then the seat ACCEPTs and arms.

## Supersedes `6210952492`: the maintainer's 「同意」 does apply, to the consumed note `.changeset/pre/23357-*` · `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · session `session_01LFqdRsuM5nkqoJdHd5ztVk` · 2026-10-16T08:04Z

`6210952492` was right that the note is no longer pending. It was wrong about what follows from that.

**What I re-read.**
- **The note is consumed, and it is still the GA source.** It was consumed by `18.0.0-next.2` into `.changeset/pre/23357-page-component-view-data-api-refused.md`, but the 18.0.0 GA entry is compiled from `.changeset/pre/`. That was measured in PR #23524 (Fixes #23498): `@changesets/assemble-release-plan` `getRelevantChangesets` drops `pre/` ids only while `pre.json` mode is not `exit`, and a trial `changeset pre exit && changeset version` printed "Please also review the changesets in the .changeset/pre folder as they will be used as changelogs for the normal versions". `.github/workflows/release.yml` says the same: "On `pre exit` the GA version consumes them all again".
- **The note I asked about is that file.** The question the maintainer answered named #23418's precedent `6203578381`. That precedent corrected two consumed `.changeset/pre/` notes (`23147-*`, `23103-*`) inside the code PR that falsified them, on the maintainer's 「同意」. That is this case exactly: this PR falsifies `.changeset/pre/23357-*`.

**So.** The correction rides this PR, in `.changeset/pre/23357-page-component-view-data-api-refused.md` in place, under the maintainer's 「同意」 (`6210183493`).
- **What is not touched:** `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md`, `content/docs/releases/**` and `.changeset/pre.json`. Each `CHANGELOG.md` entry is release-owned, and #23418 and #23524 left it as published.
- **No separate docs-only card** is filed for this.
- **`Check Changeset`** reds by design on the in-place edit, as on #23418. It is not a required context.

The dev's original dispatch said "⛔ 不改 `.changeset/pre/**`". That was the seat's own constraint, written when the note was believed released. The maintainer's word lifts it for this one file. A patch round goes to `session_016QpnMQNQ3TQ8mvWiHJwN2j` now.
